facts.text: John joined a fire-fighting brigade after being inspired by Maria's work at the homeless shelter.

evidence.quote: You mentioned your work at the homeless shelter last time and it made me think of how I could help too, so I just joined a fire-fighting brigade.
Maria: ...I dropped off that stuff I baked at the homeless shelter.

facts.text: John described his first call-out with the fire-fighting brigade as intense and rewarding.

evidence.quote: Last Sunday we had our first call-out, and it was intense. We responded to a situation and our team worked together to help those in need.

facts.text: John participated in a rescue mission where a family was saved from a burning building.

evidence.quote: we were able to save a family from a burning building.
